frames.phase: Contact: right/near foot forward, left/far behind.
frames.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE garden walking animation frame W1 for Malo bear, on perfectly flat vivid chroma green #00ff00, square canvas, no text.
Reference 1 Miffy W1 is ONLY the right-contact walking pose and blue watering can style. Reference 2 Malo home is ONLY identity: warm ochre brown round bear ears, cream muzzle, black nose, cream short-sleeve shirt and brick-red neckerchief. Reference 3 Malo water G1 sets apparent scale and position.
Draw Malo facing RIGHT in clear side/profile (one visible eye, muzzle pointing right), calmly cheerful. Right/near foot stretches forward toward right with heel contacting ground; left/far foot trails back with toes down. Generous distinct stride like Miffy. Free far arm swings BACK left, carrying near arm bent across chest holds the upright BLUE watering can, spout right, never pouring, no water. Keep large round bear head, small round ears, tuft, cream muzzle and stout bear proportions. Simple children's book raster with restrained black outlines and subtle warm texture matching Malo water.
Composition in 627px coordinates: feet ground baseline y=570, torso horizontal center x=320; head top about y=65, torso/shirt from y=295 to y=500, legs below shirt; complete silhouette including can fits within cell. Same apparent character height as Malo water G1 (~505px), same body width, no rabbit ears. Can similar blue model shown, carried at waist, spout to right. Character wholly visible. Flat green everywhere outside character and in holes. No flowers, scenery, shadows, words, extra limbs, droplets. Single frame, never sprite sheet.

notes: Exactly one W1 raster master supplies head, ear, tuft, profile face, shirt, neckerchief, carrying arm and upright dry blue can; no subject pixels drawn.
Generated upper-body drift is discarded. Head equality includes transparent silhouette boundaries; every opaque core pixel equals the master after bob compensation.

Uniform whole-source scale 1.05, offset (-14,-11); invariant torso horizontal position. W2/W4 core moves up exactly19px; support soles remain fixed.
Generated leg raster is vertically normalized beneath the shared hem, with fixed soles; original cream hem is excluded to avoid duplicate edges.
Same apparent scale and ground line as unchanged Malo watering G1: alpha>=10 baseline570, all nonzero alpha exclusive baseline572; no resizing or editing of water sheet.
Reviewed at native resolution, side by side, against water G1, and in 0.58s browser playback with mirrored left walk; complete silhouettes, two arms/two legs, clean corners and no fringe.

Change LEGS and FREE ARM only, plus rigid upward body bob 38 pixels in this 1254px square (19px in final627).
W2: right/NEAR leg straight vertically under torso, planted foot on exact SAME ground baseline as W1. Left/FAR leg is bent and lifted, passing directly next to support shin, visibly hovering above ground (about90px native), not a trailing stretched leg and not two standing feet. Follow Miffy W2 two-foot silhouette: lifted far foot visible on LEFT/back side of straight support shin, tucked under body.
Free far arm swings FORWARD to right, visible beyond torso at right shoulder/chest height, opposite the leg phase; remove backward free arm at left completely. Exactly TWO arms, one unchanged holding can and one forward free arm. Carrying can angle unchanged, do not tilt.
Head, torso, carrying hand and can move together up 38px, horizontal center unchanged, with support shin extended to maintain baseline. Match exact W1 scale and proportions. One frame only.

frames.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE W3 LEFT-CONTACT walk animation frame by editing reference1 Malo W1. Reference2 Miffy W3 is ONLY opposite-contact pose and free arm reference.
Keep exact Malo head profile/ear/tuft/face/size/position, torso cream shirt, brick-red neckerchief, carrying bent arm and same upright dry blue can at same position with rightward spout. Same square #00ff00 flat green background, scale and baseline. W3 is at SAME low body height as W1, NO bob.
Change only legs and FREE far arm. LEFT/FAR foot is now FORWARD to RIGHT with heel on ground and toes slightly raised; RIGHT/NEAR foot is BACK to LEFT with toes grounded, heel lifted. frames.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE W4 RIGHT-PASSING walk animation frame. Reference1 Malo W2 gives EXACT elevated body height and identity. Reference2 Malo W1 gives backward free arm. Reference3 Miffy W4 gives opposite passing LEGS ONLY.
Keep W2 head/profile/ear/face/torso/neckerchief/carrying arm/upright blue can unchanged at SAME elevated height and same horizontal position. Same scale, raster texture, square flat green background.
Edit two parts:
1. Below cream shirt hem: LEFT/FAR leg straight vertically under body, brown foot flat on EXACT same W2 ground baseline. RIGHT/NEAR leg bent forward, its brown foot lifted and visibly hovering to RIGHT of support shin, sole about90px above ground at native1254. Near lifted leg occludes support shin. Exactly two legs and feet. Opposite foot silhouette from W2, closely follow Miffy W4.
2. Remove W2 forward free arm/paw at RIGHT completely (including sleeve). Restore smooth torso right contour like W1. Put free arm swinging backward at LEFT like reference2 W1 with cream sleeve/brown hand. Exactly TWO arms including unchanged can-holding one.
No other changes, absolutely no head/upper body shift from W2. Upright dry blue can spout right, no water. No third arm, text, flowers, scenery, shadow or ground line. One frame W4 only.
